orevault.configuration.title: Ore Vault
orevault.configuration.resonance.target_: Hours of hand-mining that should make the whole Resonance tree purchasable. The curve is built once when the world loads, so a change here applies the next time you load it.
orevault.configuration.resonance.curve_d: Scales the whole grind without changing the curve's shape. 2.0 halves it, 0.5 doubles it. Every skill-tree level requirement keeps its intended pacing. Applies on the next world load.
orevault.configuration.chunk_loading.vau: Whether the Vault Presence nodes work at all. Off disables cross-dimension chunk loading entirely. Does nothing yet: Vault Presence has not been built.
orevault.configuration.chunk_loading.max: Hard ceiling on chunks one team can keep loaded, whatever their node level says. 0 means unlimited, which is not recommended. Does nothing yet: the chunk loader has not been built.
orevault.configuration.ore_classificatio: Force a rarity for specific ore blocks instead of letting the classifier decide. Format: modid:block_id=common|uncommon|rare. The table is built when the world loads, so a change applies the next time you load it.
orevault.configuration.disturbed_zones.m: How many Disturbed Zone blocks one team may place. Does nothing yet: Disturbed Zones are a post-1.0 feature.
orevault.configuration.reset.allow_backu: Whether a team may export a copy of their Vault before resetting it. Does nothing yet: Vault reset has not been built.
orevault.configuration.debug.enable_debu: Unlocks /orevault diag and /orevault testore, which overwrites terrain with ore. Operator permission is still required. Applies as soon as you save, no world reload needed. Playtest tooling: leave off for normal play.
orevault.configuration.debug.log_resonan: Print a chat line each time an orb pays Resonance, showing the pool, level and progress. The only readout of the pool until the Tome exists.
node.orevault.vein_expansion.desc: Ore veins in newly explored chunks are larger: +15% size, then +30%, +50%, +75%, +100%.
node.orevault.stone_memory.desc: Stone and deepslate mined in the Vault drop XP: +1 per block, rising to +2, +3, +4, +5. Tier 2 also gives stone a 10% chance to drop flint, tier 3 makes deepslate pay 0.5 Resonance, tier 4 gives stone a 2% chance to drop a raw common ore nugget, and tier 5 gives it a 0.5% chance to fire a 50 Resonance burst.
node.orevault.gravel_purge.desc: No gravel or clay generates in newly explored Vault chunks.
node.orevault.miners_constitution.desc: Hunger drains −20% slower inside the Vault, then −45%, −65%, −85%, then not at all. Tier 2 also adds +20% saturation from food, tier 3 grants Regeneration I for 5 seconds when you eat, tier 4 stops starvation damage and adds +2 max hearts, and tier 5 adds +4 max hearts. The extra hearts apply only inside the Vault.
node.orevault.sure_footing.desc: Fall damage taken inside the Vault is halved, then removed entirely.
node.orevault.deep_breath.desc: Below Y=32 inside the Vault you cannot drown. Tier 2 adds immunity to fire and lava damage below Y=32.
node.orevault.novices_luck.desc: +(30 − team level)% ore drops: +28% at team level 2, +10% at level 20, nothing at level 30. Outgrown at the level cap.
node.orevault.apprentices_ledger.desc: The first 100 ore blocks of each Vault trip pay double Resonance. The 101st onward pay normally.
node.orevault.shallow_grace.desc: +50% Resonance from all ore while your all-time deepest Y is still above 100. Going below Y=100 once ends it permanently.
node.orevault.guide_vein.desc: One copper or iron vein is guaranteed in every newly explored chunk while the team is below level 15. Chunks generated before then keep theirs afterwards.
node.orevault.salvagers_eye.desc: 5% of stone blocks you break in the Vault drop a raw common ore, while the team is below level 12. Machine-broken stone never rolls it.
node.orevault.vein_proliferation.desc: More ore veins per newly explored chunk: +20% count, then +40%, +65%, +90%, +120%. Capped so stone never falls below 40% of a chunk.
node.orevault.deep_veins.desc: The lowest 30 blocks above bedrock generate ore at 1.5× the standard density, raised to 2× at tier 2.
node.orevault.stone_reduction.desc: 10% of the stone blocks touching a vein are converted into that vein's ore, raised to 20% at tier 2. Widens the veins already there rather than adding new ones.
node.orevault.vein_shaping.desc: Sets the shape ore takes in newly generated chunks. Does nothing on its own: pick Abundance, Vein Singularity or Stratified on the ring outside, and tier 1 applies that option at its listed strength while tier 2 doubles it. Applies after Vein Expansion and Vein Proliferation and overrides both, still subject to the 40% stone floor.
node.orevault.abundance.desc: Through Vein Shaping tier 1: +50% vein count and −20% vein size. Tier 2: +100% count and −20% size. Every chunk has ore in it.
node.orevault.vein_singularity.desc: Through Vein Shaping tier 1: all of a chunk's ore is consolidated into 1–3 veins, with total volume unchanged. Tier 2: +25% total volume, and about 40% of chunks generate no ore at all.
node.orevault.stratified.desc: Ore generates in rarity-sorted horizontal bands instead of scattered blobs: rare ore only at Y=60 and below, uncommon from Y=61 to Y=150, common from Y=151 to Y=245. In an expanded Vault the rare band runs down to Y=−63. Vein Shaping tier 2 makes each band near-single-ore and sharpens the boundaries to within 4 blocks.
node.orevault.deep_habit.desc: Every 1,000 blocks broken in a single trip adds +5% Resonance for the rest of that trip, up to +25% at 5,000 blocks. Resets to zero when you leave the Vault, and counts only blocks you break yourself.
node.orevault.long_delve.desc: Every 20 minutes inside the Vault grants a Delve stack worth +10% mining speed and −25% hunger drain, up to 2 stacks, raised to 4 at tier 2. A stack only accrues while you have broken a block in the last 60 seconds, and all stacks are lost on leaving.
node.orevault.volatile_veins.desc: +25% vein size, but every ore block you break has a 3% chance to make the rest of that vein vanish into air with no drops. After 3 triggers in a row the next 10 ore breaks are guaranteed safe; that counter resets on logout. With FTB Ultimine the roll happens once per operation rather than once per block.
node.orevault.molten_seam.desc: Lava pools generate in the Vault's stone band, each inside a two-block netherrack shell so you see one before you break into it. Ore mined within 8 blocks of lava drops already smelted and pays +25% Resonance. Switching this off stops new pools generating but leaves every pool already placed.
node.orevault.greedy_seams.desc: +100% ore drops and −50% Resonance from ore. Cannot be held at the same time as Resonant Overload.
node.orevault.resonant_overload.desc: +100% Resonance from ore and −50% ore drops. Cannot be held at the same time as Greedy Seams.
node.orevault.ore_attunement.desc: Sets which rarity band the Vault favours. Does nothing on its own: pick Common, Uncommon or Rare Focus on the ring outside, and this node's 3 tiers apply through it. One Focus at a time unless Full Spectrum lifts the restriction.
node.orevault.common_focus.desc: Through Ore Attunement: +25% common ore vein count at tier 1, +50% at tier 2, +80% at tier 3.
node.orevault.uncommon_focus.desc: Through Ore Attunement: +25% uncommon ore vein count at tier 1, +50% at tier 2, +80% at tier 3.
node.orevault.rare_focus.desc: Through Ore Attunement: +30% rare ore vein count at tier 1, +60% at tier 2, +100% at tier 3.
node.orevault.geode_clusters.desc: Amethyst geodes generate in the Vault at one per 12 newly explored chunks, then one per 6. The overworld rate is roughly one per 24.
node.orevault.ancient_traces.desc: Ancient debris generates below Y=0 at one per 4 newly explored chunks, then one per 2. Needs an expanded Vault to have a band below Y=0 at all. Debris ignores every ore-multiplying node in the tree and always drops exactly one.
node.orevault.ancient_knowledge.desc: Ore blocks drop +1 bonus XP on top of their normal amount, then +2, then +4.
node.orevault.stonecutters_patience.desc: +1 XP per ore mined for every 10,000 natural stone blocks you have broken in the Vault, capped at +3, raised to +5 at tier 2.
node.orevault.calloused_hands.desc: Resonance from every ore rises with your lifetime blocks broken, by 0.03 × ln(1 + blocks / 10,000) — about +7% at 100,000 blocks and +12% at 500,000. Tier 2 raises the coefficient to 0.05 and tier 3 to 0.07, giving +17% and +28% at those counts. Hard-capped at +40%.
node.orevault.vein_sight.desc: Breaking the first block of a vein outlines the rest of that vein through solid stone for 30 seconds.
node.orevault.stonecaller.desc: Stone you break in the Vault has a 3% chance to drop the ore type of the nearest vein within 8 blocks. Nothing happens if no vein is in range, so it pays in fresh rock and not in stripped-out areas.
node.orevault.prospectors_eye.desc: Breaking the first block of a vein outlines every other vein within 16 blocks through solid stone for 5 seconds.
node.orevault.stone_curse.desc: Stone Memory XP is tripled, but stone drops no items at all inside the Vault — no cobblestone, no flint, no nuggets.
node.orevault.vein_fortune.desc: Ore mined in the Vault is treated as having Fortune I, then Fortune II, then Fortune III. Adds to the tool's own Fortune rather than replacing it.
node.orevault.ore_working.desc: Squeezes more out of each ore block. Does nothing on its own: pick Ore Doubling or Smelter's Intuition on the ring outside, and this node's tiers apply through it. Tiers 4 to 6 exist only with Ore Doubling chosen and Mekanism loaded. Vein Fortune is separate and applies on top of either option.
node.orevault.ore_doubling.desc: Through Ore Working: +25% average ore yield at tier 1, +50% at tier 2, a guaranteed 2× at tier 3. With Mekanism loaded, tier 4 drops clumps (3×), tier 5 shards (4×) and tier 6 crystals (5×). Without Mekanism it falls back to mod ore dust, then to extra raw ore.
node.orevault.smelters_intuition.desc: Through Ore Working: ore has a 15% chance to drop already smelted instead of raw at tier 1, 40% at tier 2, 75% at tier 3. No extra material — it skips the furnace.
node.orevault.runic_attunement.desc: 5% of ore drops come out Attuned, rising to 12%, then 20%. Four Attuned raw ore of any type plus one amethyst shard craft a Resonance Crystal, which every Vault Igniter upgrade and every Vault Anchor needs.
node.orevault.kindred_rock.desc: Mining 1,000 blocks of any single ore type permanently grants you +15% Resonance from that type. Tier 2 also makes attuned types break 20% faster. Tracked per player and per ore type, with no limit on how many types you can attune.
node.orevault.highwater_mark.desc: Each ore you mine repairs the held tool by 1 durability, plus 1 more for every 16 blocks your all-time deepest Y sits below Y=64 — up to 9 per ore at expanded bedrock. Tier 2 sends the same repair to damaged armour when the held tool needs none. Costs no XP and stacks with Mending.
node.orevault.brittle_stone.desc: Every block in the Vault breaks instantly. In exchange each ore block has a 10% chance to shatter with no drops, and every ore you break destroys 1 adjacent ore block with no drops.
node.orevault.vault_fever.desc: Haste II for as long as you are inside the Vault, and −25% Resonance from every ore.
node.orevault.vault_presence.desc: The team's Vault can keep 4 more chunks loaded at once, then 8 more (12 total), then 16 more (28 total). Server config caps the total, at 32 by default.
node.orevault.automated_extraction.desc: +25% ore yield from blocks broken by machines in the Vault, raised to +50%. Machine-broken blocks still award no Resonance, but they do count toward vein completion and statistics.
node.orevault.far_reach.desc: Chunks you pass through stay loaded for 30 seconds after you leave them, raised to 2 minutes. These count against the Vault Presence limit like any other, oldest evicted first.
node.orevault.seismic_sense.desc: The Tome gains a compass pointing toward denser rock, at chunk granularity. Tier 2 turns it into a map that draws explored chunks and leaves unexplored ones blank; tier 3 shades the drawn chunks by ore density.
node.orevault.wanderers_cache.desc: Every 50 newly explored Vault chunks drops a supply cache of food, torches and a tool repair. Tier 2 doubles the contents and adds a 20% chance of an enchanted book.
node.orevault.frontier_bonus.desc: Ore mined in a chunk generated within the last 10 minutes pays +40% Resonance.
node.orevault.pathfinders_claim.desc: The first vein you mine in each newly generated chunk grants 50 vanilla XP.
node.orevault.homeward_seam.desc: Set one anchor anywhere inside the Vault and teleport back to it from anywhere else inside. Five-minute cooldown, and the cast is cancelled if you take damage. Never crosses into or out of the Vault, and a dimension reset clears the anchor.
node.orevault.vault_keeps_it.desc: Items you drop on death inside the Vault never despawn and cannot be destroyed by fire, lava or explosion, and the Tome marks the spot. Carrying them out returns them to normal rules.
node.orevault.second_wind.desc: Once per Vault trip, damage that would kill you leaves you at half a heart instead. Resets when you leave the Vault.
node.orevault.second_wind_homeward.desc: While enabled, a Second Wind save also returns you to the portal you entered by, instead of leaving you where you nearly died.
node.orevault.vaults_blessing.desc: Potion effect durations do not tick down at all while you are inside the Vault. Cannot be held at the same time as Vault's Purity.
node.orevault.vaults_purity.desc: Potion effects are stripped when you enter the Vault and none can be applied inside. In exchange, while you are unaffected: +20% Resonance and +1 effective Fortune. Cannot be held at the same time as Vault's Blessing.
node.orevault.tithe.desc: 25% of the ore blocks you mine are consumed by the Vault — the block breaks and drops nothing — and each consumed block pays 1.75× its Resonance instead. Only ore blocks are taken: Stone Memory drops, nuggets and flint are untouched.
node.orevault.vault_echo.desc: Mining a vein to completion pays a burst of 25 Resonance, rising to 35, then 50.
node.orevault.echo_chamber.desc: Vault Echo bursts also grant vanilla XP equal to the Resonance awarded, so a 50 Resonance burst is also 50 XP.
node.orevault.twin_veins.desc: Completing a vein has a 1% chance to spawn a second identical vein next to it, rising to 5%, then 10%. The new vein is indexed like any other, so it can trigger this again.
node.orevault.last_ore.desc: The final ore block of any vein drops double and pays double Resonance. Stacks with the Vault Echo burst, which is counted separately.
node.orevault.clean_cut.desc: A vein completed without breaking a single non-ore block between its first and last ore pays +50% Resonance across the whole vein.
node.orevault.vein_discipline.desc: +2% Resonance for each vein completed in a row, stacking to +30% at 15 veins and persisting across trips. Abandoning a part-mined vein — leaving the Vault or moving more than 48 blocks away with ore still standing — drops the streak by 3 rather than resetting it.
node.orevault.chapters_end.desc: Completing 5 veins within a single chunk fires a 150 Resonance burst and reveals every vein still standing in that chunk. Counted over all time rather than per trip, so each chunk fires once.
node.orevault.deep_harvest.desc: Ore mined below Y=0 drops 1 extra Resonance orb. Only an expanded Vault has a band below Y=0 for this to apply in.
node.orevault.resonant_draw.desc: Changes how Resonance orbs reach you. Does nothing on its own: pick Resonance Magnetism or Hoarder's Instinct on the ring outside, and this node's 3 tiers apply through it.
node.orevault.resonance_magnetism.desc: Through Resonant Draw: orbs are pulled to you from 8 blocks at tier 1, 16 blocks at tier 2, 24 blocks at tier 3.
node.orevault.hoarders_instinct.desc: Orbs never move toward you and never despawn; orbs resting within 4 blocks of each other merge into a single cache. Through Resonant Draw tier 2, collecting a cache of N orbs pays ×(1 + 0.1 × N) up to ×3; tier 3 lets caches pull in orbs from other caches within 8 blocks and raises the cap to ×4.
node.orevault.ultimine_expansion.desc: +25% to the maximum number of blocks FTB Ultimine breaks per operation inside the Vault, then +50%, then +100%.
node.orevault.ultimine_safety.desc: −1% Volatile Veins disappearance chance during Ultimine operations, then −2%. Against Volatile Veins' 3% base that leaves Ultimine operations at 2%, then 1% — reduced, never zero.
node.orevault.ultimine_gambit.desc: While Volatile Veins is active, each Ultimine operation counts 1 extra block toward the disappearance roll. Operations that survive it pay +20% Resonance.
node.orevault.vault_expansion.desc: Bedrock moves from Y=0 down to Y=−64, opening a 63-block deepslate band that carries the highest ore density in the mod. Takes effect only on a dimension reset, which regenerates the Vault and everything built in it.
node.orevault.full_spectrum.desc: The two Ore Focus options you did not choose apply at 50% strength alongside the one you did, and every ore pays −20% Resonance.
node.orevault.silent_stone.desc: Ore pays no Resonance at all. The team pool instead gains 3 Resonance per second while you are below Y=0 inside the Vault, and only while you have broken a block in the last 10 seconds.
node.orevault.resonant_symbiosis.desc: While 2 or more team members are inside the Vault at once, each of them gains +50% Resonance and +25% ore. Alone inside the Vault, −40% Resonance.
node.orevault.bedrock_communion.desc: +2% Resonance and ore per block below Y=0, reaching +126% at Y=−63. Between Y=32 and Y=245 ore pays no Resonance at all and mining speed is halved. At Y=246 and above there is no penalty, so surface builds and machine floors are untouched.
node.orevault.zone_frequency.desc: +25% mob spawn frequency inside Disturbed Zones, then +50%, +80%, +120%.
node.orevault.zone_pack_size.desc: +1 mob per spawn attempt in Disturbed Zones, then +2, then +3.
node.orevault.zone_radius.desc: Each Disturbed Zone block spawns mobs within 32 blocks instead of the default 16, raised to 48, then 64.
node.orevault.mob_diversity.desc: Adds undead to Disturbed Zone spawns (zombies, skeletons, wither skeletons), then arthropods (spiders, cave spiders, silverfish), then illagers (vindicators, evokers, pillagers), then witches and endermen.
node.orevault.reapers_claim.desc: +50% XP from mobs killed in Disturbed Zones, then +100%, then +150%.
node.orevault.corrupted_veins.desc: 5% of mobs killed in Disturbed Zones drop a random common raw ore in place of their normal loot, rising to 10% including uncommon ores, then 15% including rare ores.
node.orevault.plunderers_share.desc: +25% item drop quantity from mobs killed in Disturbed Zones, then +50%, then +80%.
node.orevault.animus_amplifier.desc: +25% Animus per mob kill, then +50%, then +80%.
node.orevault.soul_harvest.desc: 5% of mobs killed drop a Soul Harvest item. It is the currency for a Vault Shop that does not exist yet, so this node buys nothing today.
